UK Defence Plan Faces Criticism Amidst Political Transition

British Prime Minister Keir Starmer has unveiled a £15 billion defence investment plan, reportedly funded by reallocating resources from energy, transport, and housing projects. The plan, which faced delays, has drawn criticism from within his own party and the Liberal Democrats, who deem it insufficient. Starmer is also set to resign, with his successor Andy Burnham expected to take over, raising questions about the continuity of these defence ambitions and past UK-Africa partnership goals.
